rules.explanation: Worked example 12 says capex is checked before contracts and value limits.
Worked example 13: item absent from master is sourced, valued at requester estimate, and not clubbed.
Worked example 8: emergency requirement up to ₹5 lakh with purchase history may go to first preferred supplier.
Worked example 7: below ₹2 lakh and bought in last year goes to first preferred supplier.
Worked example 9: ₹2 lakh to below ₹10 lakh requires RFQ with 3 suggestions.
Worked example 11: ₹10 lakh or above requires RFP with 5 suggestions.

notes: Contract precedence, contract ceilings, contract-only PDFs, item matching, valuation and full rule ordering are not fully represented.
The exact source policy v5.0 must replace this partial extraction before real decisions are relied upon.
